paths.name: react
paths.message: Use named imports instead of the default React import.

paths.name: styled-components
paths.message: Use `import { styled } from 'styled-components'`: Node ESM resolves the default import to the CommonJS exports object.

paths.name: react-merge-refs
paths.message: Use `mergeRefs` from `src/utils/shared/mergeRefs`: the package is ESM-only and breaks CommonJS consumers.

paths.name: dom-helpers
paths.message: Use the helpers in `src/utils/shared/dom`: dom-helpers subpaths break Node ESM and webpack 5.

patterns.message: Use the helpers in `src/utils/shared/dom`: dom-helpers subpaths break Node ESM and webpack 5.
